title: Oven Braised Slovakian Mushroom Stew
description: A hearty, charred Slovakian dish featuring bacon lardon and mushrooms, perfect for a cold winter night, this vegan-friendly version uses plant-based bacon alternatives.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large kazan cauldron, cook the diced plant-based bacon over medium heat until crispy.
Remove the bacon from the cauldron and set aside, leaving the grease behind.
Add the chopped onion to the cauldron and cook until translucent.
Add the minced garlic to the cauldron and cook for an additional minute.
Add the mushrooms to the cauldron and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown.
Add the caraway seeds, paprika, vegetable broth, and tomato paste to the cauldron, stirring to combine.
Return the cooked bacon to the cauldron and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Cover the cauldron and transfer it to the preheated oven, braising the stew for 30 minutes.
Remove the cauldron from the oven and serve the stew hot.
